$comment: Excuses for scripts/check-doc-refs.mjs — bare docs/ and spec/ references in files OUTSIDE the documentation corpus (source, tests, workflows, migrations, shell). An entry that excuses nothing FAILS the run, so this list self-cleans. Prefer `perFile` over a repo-wide `paths` entry: a dead reference that is deliberate in one file is usually a genuine bug in another.

perFile.reason: Not a document. This is the `md` step of the spacing scale — a design-token property path, written in backticks in a TODO-DESIGN comment, which is shaped exactly like a bare markdown filename. Two sites in this one file; scoped per-file on purpose, because the same token elsewhere would more likely be a real dead pointer.

Migration files are treated as immutable, so a stale header comment is left as shipped — the same call docs/internal/ops/DB_PROMOTION_RUNBOOK.md records for 20260824120000_discord_import.sql (#1409). The content moved to spec/architecture/README.md when spec/architecture.md was split (epic #432); this comment records what the schema was generated from at the time, which is historically accurate.
